method.pacing: chunk sent when its last sample would have been spoken (start + audio time of chunk end); tails < 20 ms merged into the previous chunk
method.session: one fresh WebSocket session per clip, opened and configured before audio starts (connect time is not in latency)
method.latency: performance.now() at final-transcript message arrival minus performance.now() just after the last audio chunk was handed to the socket; the end-of-turn signal is sent immediately after the last chunk
method.normalization: stt/normalize.ts (lowercase, punctuation stripped, numbers to single digits, spelling equivalences)
method.wer: corpus-level: total substitutions+deletions+insertions / total reference tokens; a line with no transcript counts as all deleted
